hints.content: On a  number line, numbers to the right are greater than numbers to the left.
The values of $\blueD{-1.2}$, $\goldD{-0.1}$, and $\green{0.8}$  are to the right of $\redD{-1.5}$ .
The values that make the inequality true are  $\blueD{-1.2}$, $\goldD{-0.1}$, and $\green{0.8}$.
